button.label: Insert Figure Package
button.supertip: Choose a folder containing plot.png. The add-in embeds the whole folder as a zip OLE object and displays plot.png.

button.label: Insert Image + Files
button.screentip: Insert an image with selected support files
button.supertip: Open a dialog where you can review the selected image and support files before embedding the files as a zip OLE object.

button.label: Attach Files to Image
button.screentip: Attach support files to the selected image
button.supertip: Select an existing picture in the document, then attach support files while preserving the picture size and position.

button.label: Usage
button.supertip: Learn how to prepare plot.py, plot.png, and raw data before inserting a figure package.
